title: SvgFeComposite
responsibility: Renders the native feComposite element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgFeComposite.attributes
inputs.description: Native feComposite attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: SvgFeComposite.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native feComposite element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: SvgFeComposite
outputs.description: The actual native feComposite element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
